schema.title: Client checks settings (QuickBooks)
schema.description: Ledger checks settings for one business kept in QuickBooks. Submit it once per business, and again whenever something changes. A QuickBooks connection reaches one company, so the automations’ owner connects QuickBooks to this business’s company.

questions.label: QuickBooks company name (exactly as it appears in QuickBooks)
Is this business registered for GST?
Run the ledger checks on this business’s QuickBooks file?
Who follows up its findings? (leave blank to use the practice default)
Does this business lodge a taxable payments annual report (TPAR)? (building and construction, cleaning, courier, road freight, IT, security and investigation services)
Suspense or clearing account codes to watch, separated by commas (optional; accounts named suspense, clearing or uncoded are watched anyway)
